description: This is a Java source file defining the 'Manufacturer' class, which serves as an entity representing a manufacturer in the e-commerce system. It includes fields for manufacturer details, descriptions, images, and related methods.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: A serializable class representing a manufacturer entity, including attributes such as manufacturer details, descriptions, order, and image information.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the uploaded image file (MultipartFile) associated with the manufacturer.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the uploaded image file (MultipartFile) for the manufacturer.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Returns the product image (ProductImage) associated with the manufacturer.

methods.name: setProductImage
methods.description: Sets the product image (ProductImage) for the manufacturer.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the core manufacturer object containing manufacturer details.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of manufacturer descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of manufacturer descriptions.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order (priority or sequence) of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order (priority or sequence) of the manufacturer.
